title: Phát triển các ứng dụng trong quản lý

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge on the importance of IT in management and the concepts of commercial software applications.
Design and implement database systems for management applications.
Develop software applications using programming languages such as C#.
Create user-friendly interfaces for management applications.
Implement security measures and manage data in software applications.
Work independently and collaboratively in team settings.
Organize and manage group activities effectively.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.

prerequisite_courses: Ứng dụng cơ sở dữ liệu
